title: Brittle by Design? Multi-Scenario Reinforcement Learning for Robust Mission Coordination in Systems of Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.28818v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As systems engineering (SE) shifts from monolithic systems to Systems of Systems, Mission Engineering (ME) has emerged as a new line of thinking in SE. Mission environments are uncertain and dynamic, and outcomes depend on how mission assets interact with them, rendering static architectures brittle and calling for flexible yet analytically rigorous ME approaches. We propose an intelligent mission coordination methodology integrating high-fidelity digital mission models with Reinforcement Learning (RL) for adaptive task allocation. Using a Digital Engineering (DE) infrastructure comprising a digital mission model and agent-based simulation, we formulate mission tactics management as a Markov Decision Process and train an RL coordinator with Proximal Policy Optimization to map mission states to tactical actions from realized outcomes. translated_title: 设计如此脆弱？面向体系鲁棒任务协同的多场景强化学习
translated_abstract: 随着系统工程从单体系统转向体系，任务工程已成为系统工程领域的一种新思路。任务环境具有不确定性和动态性，任务结果取决于任务资产与环境的交互方式，这使得静态架构变得脆弱，因而需要既灵活又分析严谨的任务工程方法。我们提出了一种智能任务协同方法，将高保真数字任务模型与强化学习相结合，以实现自适应任务分配。依托由数字任务模型和基于代理的仿真构成的数字工程基础设施，我们将任务战术管理形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，并使用近端策略优化训练强化学习协调器，根据实际任务结果将任务状态映射到战术动作。通过包含三个场景的航空灭火任务对该方法进行了演示。
tldr: 该论文提出一种将高保真数字任务模型与基于近端策略优化的强化学习相结合的智能任务协同方法，并通过多场景航空灭火任务验证了其在不确定动态环境下实现体系鲁棒自适应任务分配的有效性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an intelligent mission coordination methodology integrating high-fidelity digital mission models with Proximal Policy Optimization-based reinforcement learning, demonstrating through multi-scenario aerial firefighting missions its effectiveness in achieving robust, adaptive task allocation for Systems of Systems in uncertain and dynamic environments.
